author: Sarah Jenkins
title: Unforgettable red dunes experience at Al Khayma Camp!
comment: From our driver Tariq picking us up right on time in a pristine Land Cruiser, to the breathtaking sunset dunes and the food at Al Khayma - everything was world-class. The three buffets catered to all tastes and the stargazing atmosphere was pure magic.
experienceTitle: Dubai: Red Dune Quad Biking, Camel Ride, Al Khayma Camp & BBQ

author: Maximilian Müller
title: Grand Mosque and Louvre Abu Dhabi was seamless
comment: The tour guide was knowledgeable and provided deep historical context for the Grand Mosque. Having the skip-the-line ticket to Louvre Abu Dhabi saved us an hour. Outstanding service from OceanAir.
experienceTitle: Abu Dhabi: Full-Day Tour with Sheikh Zayed Mosque & Louvre

author: Elena Rossi
title: Incredible desert confluence in Doha
comment: Where the sand dunes meet the sea is a sight you must see once in your lifetime. Highly recommended operator with friendly drivers and top safety standards.
experienceTitle: Doha: Half-Day Desert Safari, Dune Bashing & Inland Sea Khor Al Adaid
